title: About Us – Micro Hair Clinic Scalp Micropigmentation

hero.heading: About Us – Micro Hair Clinic Ljubljana | Hair Tattoo Artist Srđan Kostovski
hero.subtitle: Restoring confidence with micropigmentation – this is our true mission.
bullets: Micro Hair Clinic is more than just a scalp micropigmentation studio.
It is a place where men and women rediscover themselves in the mirror.
Our founder, Srđan Kostovski, is among the most awarded SMP artists in Europe – but most importantly, he has personally experienced hair loss and knows what it feels like.

sections.title: Srđan's Story
text: "I started losing my hair early. It wasn't an instant shock – more a feeling of gradually losing a part of myself. I didn't run from it, but I wanted a solution that wouldn't look like a 'solution.'"
"I studied hair tattoo micropigmentation, analyzed results, observed every dot. I decided – not just to perform the treatment, but to master this skill to perfection."
Srđan completed his scalp micropigmentation training in Milan and opened the first SMP studio in the Balkans in 2015.
Today his work is recognized across Europe, and his technique is considered a standard for a natural SMP appearance.
bullets: Gold Award 2023 – Best SMP Artist in Europe and UK (TeamMicro)
Best SMP Artist 2024 – SMP Connect Conference, Portugal
Top 10 SMP Artists in EU 2024 – selected by TeamMicro
Micro Hair Clinic is officially listed among recommended European SMP centers (TeamMicro)

sections.title: Our Philosophy
text: In an industry where many focus on 'getting clients,' we first listen.
We don’t offer a treatment if it’s not needed.
If there’s a chance to restore your hair naturally – we say it.
If you choose SMP, you get a treatment that looks:
tailored to your appearance and style
with results that last for years
"We don’t draw hair – we restore identity." – Srđan Kostovski
